construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored in the isolated build directory

input.catalog: currency USD/EUR/GBP; products with unique sku, name, nonnegative integer price_cents and stock
input.customer: customer_id, synthetic persona, explicit boolean gdpr/ccpa consent, personalization_requested
input.basket: order_id, matching customer_id, unique SKU items and positive integer quantity within stock
input.clickstream: event_id, matching customer_id, known sku, view/click/add_to_basket action, timezone-aware ISO timestamp
input.documents: unique document_id, title, source_id, synthetic true, structured claims
input.claims: globally unique claim_id, known sku, durability/packaging/ease_of_use topic, positive/negative/uncertain value, specification/analyst_observation/return_summary evidence_kind
input.research_questions: unique question_id, known sku, supported topic

shared_schema.output: schema_version, status, synthetic, research, catalog_snapshot, basket, limitations; error envelope has schema_version, status error, error message
shared_schema.validation: One validate function checks input and source-grounded canonical output; strict object fields, duplicate JSON key rejection, nonfinite number rejection, array length at most 1000, identifiers/text at most 2000 characters.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single Research functionality: validated shared input -> SKU/topic evidence groups -> canonical output checked against the same validated source.

behavior.research: Deterministic multi-document synthesis with exact document/claim/source provenance; positive and negative evidence is disputed without majority voting. Uncertain evidence is inconclusive; agreement across two supplied source IDs is corroborated; one source is insufficient. Questions without claims are no_evidence. Unresolved items include next steps. Missing SKU coverage and personalized out-of-scope questions are explicit.
behavior.personalization: Generic mode ignores persona/clickstream for synthesis selection. Personalized SKU selection uses basket and clickstream only after both GDPR and CCPA consent flags are true.
behavior.retail_integrity: Prices use exact integer cents. Displayed price and stock are copied from the catalog; basket totals derive from catalog prices. Reviews and endorsements are unsupported and rejected as evidence kinds. No review prose or endorsements are generated.
behavior.cli: One JSON object on stdout; exit 0 success, exit 2 validation or file errors.
behavior.llm: No LLM step; deterministic synthesis only.

included: Clickstream event log as JSON array
Demonstrative consent and catalog integrity rules

test_outcomes.cli_example: passed: one JSON object with status ok, exit 0
test_outcomes.error_cli_result: Missing file, argument, malformed JSON, duplicate key, nonfinite number and schema errors return status error and exit 2
